extendedData.value:
The Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty Bundle Case contains 6 The Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty Bundles, each containing 8 Set Boosters—the best boosters to open just for fun—plus exclusive accessories, with 40 basic lands (20 traditional foils and 20 nonfoils), 1 traditional foil promo card with Bundle-exclusive alternate art, 1 oversized Spindown life counter, 1 card storage box, and 2 reference cards.
Each Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty Set Booster contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token, ad card, Helper card, or special card from Magic's history (a card from "The List"), with a combination of 1–4 cards of rarity Rare or higher, 2–7 Uncommons, 3–8 Common cards, and 1 Land card in every pack.

Key Product Features:
• 8 Kamigawa: Neon Dynasty MTG Set Boosters
• 1 foil alt-art promo card
• 40 basic land cards (20 foil + 20 nonfoil)
• Spindown life counter + card storage box
• With cyberpunk cards full of color and chrome—the future is bright in Kamigawa
